Marker_HeroSpot.channels: U across the road (spot width), V along the road. R two rails, G soft fill towards the rails, B centre crest (small open diamond); pulse B slowly

Marker_HeroSpot.note: unit quad: scale X = cells*(width-SpotMargin), Z = cell*(1-SpotMargin); local X across the road (code: LookRotation(along))
